overview_description.description:
Gas Pos is the the most modern fuel point of sale system for gas stations, truck stops, convenience stores & marinas across the USA. Additionally, we're pleased to announce that Gas Pos is the first truck stop point of sale alternative with fleet card acceptance in 20 years.

Gas Pos was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.

product.name: Fuel Point of Sale System (Fuel POS)
product.description: A cloud-based point of sale system designed for gas stations and truck stops to manage fuel sales and transactions.

product.name: EMV Fuel Dispensers and Pumps
product.description: Hardware equipment including EMV-compliant fuel dispensers and pumps for gas stations and truck stops to securely dispense fuel.

product.name: Advanced Back Office Software
product.description: Cloud-based back office software for managing gas station and truck stop operations, including inventory and pricing.

product.name: Equipment as a Service Program
product.description: A subscription-based program providing hardware, software, installation, and maintenance services for gas station POS and fuel dispensing equipment.

product.name: Gas Pos Merchant Services (Payment Processing)
product.description: Payment processing services integrated with the Gas Pos system, supporting credit, debit, fleet cards, and loyalty programs.
